rule: Definitions are copied from preserved database/repository evidence. Missing definitions remain DEFINITION_NOT_RECOVERED.

fields.definition: Confidence in the relationship basis, not a population share or traffic share.
fields.join_notes: Row joins census-zone and infrastructure-node subjects.
fields.misuse_warning: Do not normalize confidence values into demographic allocation weights.

fields.definition: LOCATED_IN identifies the node's primary census-zone context; GATEWAY_FOR identifies a supported access/service relation to another zone.
fields.join_notes: Use node_subject_id and zone_subject_id; relation never transfers population.
fields.misuse_warning: Does not imply all zone residents use the facility.

fields.definition: Productive capital stock allocated to country/sector/asset.
fields.misuse_warning: Capital/person is location capital intensity, not household wealth.

fields.definition: Gross capital formation including replacement and expansion.
fields.misuse_warning: High sector investment/value-added can mostly be replacement; gross investment is not net expansion.

fields.definition: Value added produced at the country location in the modeled economy.
fields.misuse_warning: Value-added per person/worker is production intensity, not household income, wages, or consumption.

fields.definition: Country-lineage/disputed-polity operating-profile scores summarize continuity, institutional embedding and relative state capacity for gameplay differentiation.
fields.misuse_warning: Do not use profile scores as population, GDP, capital, migration, synthetic-population, or infrastructure allocation weights. federal_coherence is internal state/territorial coherence for non-federal states.

fields.definition: Biological resident population at the row geography/year.
fields.misuse_warning: Do not add transient population unless explicitly asking for present headcount.

fields.definition: Legally/socially recognized synthetic persons at the row geography/year.
fields.join_notes: Distinct from workforce and machine-task capacity tables.
fields.misuse_warning: Do not treat synthetic persons as interchangeable with non-person automation or machine-task equivalents.

fields.definition: Transient nonresident population associated with the geography.
fields.join_notes: Separate from resident biological and synthetic population totals.
fields.misuse_warning: Not part of resident population and should not be double-counted in census totals.

fields.definition: Annual ship-call throughput normalized by utilization, expressed in one-call-per-day-at-full-use equivalent units.
Estimated occupied-equivalent accommodation capacity implied by resident + transient daily population and current utilization.
fields.misuse_warning: Not certified life-support capacity, emergency refuge capacity, or a claim that workforce is physically resident.

fields.definition: Relative 2226 industrial scale across the 127-node network from five equal-weight operational/economic signals.
fields.misuse_warning: Not an absolute production ceiling and not physically comparable across model versions if the node universe changes.

fields.definition: Deterministic node-specific gameplay texture derived from infrastructure and influence state.
fields.misuse_warning: Infrastructure nodes are facilities, not full settlements.

fields.definition: Longer-lived place character prior; node texture overlays current operating conditions rather than replacing Place DNA.
fields.misuse_warning: Do not random-jitter duplicate node-family priors merely to manufacture uniqueness.

fields.join_notes: Combines synthetic population and workforce aggregates at zone grain.
fields.misuse_warning: Current values inherit coarse workforce allocation templates and are not age-based demographic participation.

fields.definition: Relative accessibility used by the origin-destination allocator.
fields.misuse_warning: Local/system values are topology classes; intersystem values use parent ephemeris distance and are not door-to-door travel times.

fields.definition: Modeled annual origin-destination corridor demand constrained to node incidence marginals.
fields.misuse_warning: Not a timetable, scheduled service count, unique traveler count, or guaranteed direct route.

fields.definition: Automation capacity expressed as labor-task equivalents; not a person count.
fields.misuse_warning: Never add machine_task_equivalent to synthetic_population or recognized persons.

fields.definition: Synthetic workers are recognized synthetic persons participating in economic labor.
fields.misuse_warning: Current worker/person ratios are tiered role-allocation priors, not mature life-cycle participation estimates.
